name: rain_glass

source.title: 120503 rain on skylight window interior 2012
source.author: TRP
source.notes: 48 kHz 24-bit stereo, 89 s of rain on a skylight heard from inside, mixed to mono: drops ticking on the glass over a low drumming, steady throughout (within 1.5 dB, sound-ambience.py). Chosen by the author over carthny's (522322), Vrymaa's (810879), AmiableWookie's (651676) and mmorgaine's (333510) rain on windows (see SOUND_REWORK.md). Stretches picked for the most drops (7-10 a second, 4 dB over their 1 s median, 1-8 kHz), none more than 7.7 dB over it (no spikes), level steady within 1 dB between halves (scratchpad pick_swells.py). High-passed at 200 Hz, as the drumming under 200 Hz is half the recording's level and the filtered glass rain keeps little of it.

shape: 2 s swells (0.6 s in, 0.5 s out), as the calm and medium rain's, played with them where a rain sound lands on glass (RainSurface.GLASS), in place of most of it (the filtered rain keeps 0.3). Cut at the calm rain's average level (RMS about -46 dB); how loud it plays against the rain is set in code.
